content.title: When was the last tie at the Oscars?
content.text: POP-CULTUREWhen was the last tie at the Oscars?Mary ClarkeFor The WinMarch 15, 2026, 8:28 p.m. ETKeep WatchingTies aren't very common at the Oscars but, as we all saw on Sunday night, they can still happen!During the 2026 Oscars broadcast, two films won for the Best Live Action Short category. In a surprise moment, both The Singers and Two People Exchanging Saliva were announced as the winners of the category in a tie. It was really cool to see, as both production crews went on stage to accept the award one after the other and gave their acceptance speeches.But, when was the last time a tie occurred at the Oscars? Well, according to the Academy Awards, the last tie occurred during the 85th Oscars, when both Skyfall and Zero Dark Thirty won for Sound Editing in 2013.
